text: G'day legends, welcome to Joystick Jammers! Grab a controller and make a spectacular mess.
caption: G'day legends, welcome to Joystick Jammers! Grab a controller and make a spectacular mess.

text: Welcome, mate! Scan the code, pick your car and give it a burl.
caption: Welcome, mate! Scan the code, pick your car and give it a burl.

text: Righto, welcome to Joystick Jammers! New to this? No worries, you'll get the hang of it.
caption: Righto, welcome to Joystick Jammers! New to this? No worries, you'll get the hang of it.

text: Welcome, blokes and sheilas! Grab a controller, this arvo's racing is on.
caption: Welcome, blokes and sheilas! Grab a controller, this arvo's racing is on.

text: Everyone's ready, legends. Strap in, this is going to get messy!
caption: Everyone's ready, legends. Strap in, this is going to get messy!

text: All ready! Fair dinkum, this one's going to be a ripper!
caption: All ready! Fair dinkum, this one's going to be a ripper!

text: Everyone's locked in. Let's give it a burl!
caption: Everyone's locked in. Let's give it a burl!

text: Three! Two! One! Go, go, go!
caption: 3... 2... 1... GO!

text: Three! Two! One! Off you go!
caption: 3... 2... 1... Off you go!

text: Three! Two! One! Let her rip, you legends!

text: The first car's home! I reckon the clock's ticking!

text: We've got a finisher! Who's next across the line?

text: First one's across! Hurry up, you galahs!

text: Strewth, that was close!
caption: Strewth, that was close!

text: A fair dinkum finish! Nobody gave an inch.
caption: A fair dinkum finish! Nobody gave an inch.

text: And that's time! Well driven, legends.
caption: And that's time! Well driven, legends.

text: That's time! No worries if you didn't make the line.
caption: That's time! No worries if you didn't make the line.

text: Righto, time's up! The race is over.
caption: Righto, time's up! The race is over.

text: Yeah nah, not this time. The round's over, cheers for racing.
caption: Yeah nah, not this time. The round's over, cheers for racing.

text: And that's the race! Give the winner a big cheer. You beauty!
